page_title: JUV 2-0 TOR | Juventus v Torino 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
90+1' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner with a short pass.

89' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antonio Sanabria (Torino) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mattia Perin pulls off an easy save.
88' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Mattia Perin (Juventus).
87' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Danilo (Juventus) comes onto the pitch for Nicolo Savona.
86' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Weston McKennie (Juventus).
84' 2 - 0 Spectacular goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yann Karamoh (Torino) replaces Valentino Lazaro.
82' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will deliver the corner kick.
80' Saul Coco (Torino) gets a yellow card for protesting.
78' 10:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
75' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Marcus Pedersen will be replaced by Borna Sosa (Torino).
73' It's time for a substitution. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) comes on in place of Dusan Vlahovic.
72' Goal, no wait. Simone Sozza blows his whistle for handball and Timothy Weah (Juventus) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
70' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
67' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
64' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Samuele Ricci and he is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
64' The substitution has been made. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) has replaced Sebastian Walukiewicz.
62' Samuele Ricci (Torino) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) sees a yellow card from Simone Sozza after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
58' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Today's referee Simone Sozza rightly decides to book Valentino Lazaro (Torino) for his harsh tackle.
56' Karol Linetty (Torino) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
54' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
52' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
51' Torino string together a series of short passes.
48' Karol Linetty (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Juventus will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) and Ivan Ilic is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Juventus players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
42' The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
40' Now Juventus have a corner.
38' The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
35' The referee awards a corner and Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) goes over to take it.
34' Surely that's handball by one of the Torino players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
34' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

33' Samuele Ricci (Torino) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
32' Torino try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
30' The ball is behind the sideline. Nicolo Savona (Juventus) takes a throw-in.
28' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
26' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
25' The ball is out of play. Juventus will take a throw-in.
22' The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Timothy Weah (Juventus) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
15' The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
14' Ivan Ilic (Torino) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
12' The linesman signals a throw-in for Torino.
10' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
5' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
2' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza will referee today's match.
